problem: Malformed and unsupported refusal traces could omit the observed refused stage while retaining terminal refusal fields, and still verify as complete.

invariants.budget_over_stages: unchanged existing admitted-prefix + refused + probe_exit requirement
invariants.meaning: A terminal refusal without the intervening observed refusal stage is not a complete run.

before.detail: All six refused-stage removals (truncated, bad_masks, overlap_masks, bad_header, inconsistent, unsupported) verified ok=true before the repair.

negative_method: For each of the six actual cases, remove only the refused stage, renumber remaining seq, and recompute trace bytes/digest/records; terminal reason and probe result stay unchanged. Each must fail with native_stage_set_incomplete.

native_refresh.reason: The verifier is part of the recorded Native source identity, so the retained record is regenerated by a new real-WIC run from the repaired source rather than edited.
native_refresh.meaning: Fresh actual WIC observation and separately built decode_compare consumer; not a replay relabeled as a new run.

gate_and_review: Changed source requires its own pinned Gate pair and complete Tern re-review. Round-two receipts remain historical and are not transferred.
